::: {.page-hero}
::: {.page-hero-inner}
# Codebook

Describing variable definitions, data coverage, measurement units, coding rules, and derived variables.
:::
:::

::: {.cards .codebook-cards}
::: {.card}
### Administrative Indicators

Uses the 2002 administrative division codes (GB/T 2260-2002) as the unified geographic coding standard, while preserving original place names recorded in local gazetteers.
:::
::: {.card}
### Historical Transformation Indicators

Includes indicators identifying whether regions experienced land reform, socialist transformation, and different historical stages of revolutionary change.
:::
::: {.card}
### Data Coverage Indicators

Distinguishes between county-level records, representative villages, partial samples, as well as tabular data and textual descriptions.
:::
::: {.card}
### Core Economic Indicators Before and After Land Reform

Includes household numbers, population, land area, average land area per household and person, proportions, and measurement units by social class.
:::
::: {.card}
### Redistribution and Confiscation Indicators

Includes information on the confiscation and redistribution of land, housing, agricultural tools, livestock, grain, and other productive assets and properties.
:::
:::

## Codebook Examples {.section-title}

::: {.table-wrap}
| Variable | Definition | Type | Example | Description |
|--------|----------|------|------|------|
| prov | Province | String | Sichuan Province | Name of the provincial-level administrative unit |
| county_code | County/District Code | String | 510123 | Unified spatial identification code for county-level units |
| yesno_gazette_dummy | Availability of Gazetteer Records | String | Available | Indicates whether usable local gazetteer materials were identified for the region |
| tables_types_label | Table or Text Type | String | Pre-land-reform Survey Table | Identifies the type of source material, such as pre-land-reform survey tables, land ownership tables before/after reform, and class composition tables |
| pre_total_hh | Total Households Before Land Reform | Numeric | 42631 | Total number of households within the statistical scope before land reform |
| pre_total_area | Total Land Area Before Land Reform | Numeric | 652318.5 | Total land area within the statistical scope before land reform |

:::
